note: Electron release archives pinned by sha256 from the official SHASUMS256.txt (cross-checked against the GitHub release). Bumping Electron means updating both the version and every hash here deliberately; prepare-runtime refuses an archive that does not match. The 44.10.0 digests were read from SHASUMS256.txt served by the npmmirror binary mirror on 2026-10-29 because github.com was unreachable from the build host, and independently re-derived from the win32-x64 archive the install actually downloaded and runs; the remaining four targets carry the published SHASUMS value alone and are re-checked the first time each of them is packaged.
